data.description: Burj View | Connected to Dubai Mall | 3 Bath
data.long_description:
This exclusive 2-bedroom apartment is located on a high floor and offers a stunning view of Burj Khalifa and the Dubai Fountain. The floor to ceiling windows let in an abundance of natural day light which gives the apartment a light and airy living experience.

Both bedrooms are ensuite which offers privacy and convenience for the residents. Kitchen appliances included.

The tower is directly connected to the Dubai Mall. By elevator you can go to the 6th floor which gives you direct access the Dubai Mall Zabeel Extension; which features 2 supermarkets, restaurants, fashion and much more.

The Apartment:

-2-bedroom, 1,217.61 sq. ft (113.12 sq. m)
-Full BURJ KHALIFA & FOUNTAIN VIEW
-Kitchen appliances included
-2.5 Bathrooms
-HIGH FLOOR
-Floor to ceiling windows

-Ceiling height; 3.2 m
-With balcony

Amenities:
-Pool and state of the art gym on the 9th floor
-Direct access to the Dubai mall from level 6
-Kids pool and play area
-Residence lounge (9th floor)
-Hotel style reception lobby on ground level
-Direct & easy access from the financial road (you avoid getting stuck in downtown traffic)

The Dubai Mall Zabeel Extension shops:
-Grandiose Supermarket
-Lulu Hypermarket
-Bin Sinai pharmacy

-Fakeeh university hospital

-Whites Laundry

-Costa Coffee
-Luna Café (coffee shop)

-Gym (TRAIN)
-Mc Donald`s & MC Café
-Air-conditioned connection Bridge to Dubai Mall Fashion Avenue
-And much more.
